tools.name: find_booking_pages
tools.description: Lists booking pages of holiday apartments whose hosts let AI assistants find them: name, place and the bookingPageId the other tools take. Give a few words of the name or the place to narrow the list (at most 20).

tools.name: get_booking_page
tools.description: Reads one booking page: description, place, check-in and check-out times, the host, the cancellation terms and each apartment with how many it sleeps and its lowest nightly price. Amounts are decimal strings. onlineBooking says whether guests can book on the page now; when false, it carries the host

tools.name: search_availability
tools.description: Which apartments of a booking page are free for the dates and guests, with the full price and a bookingUrl that opens the booking step for that apartment and stay.
